projects.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineering Intern
projects.description: Media generation models for digital marketing
projects.summary: contributed to the development of the student extranet for the private faculty ITECH, working on both the front-end and back-end.
key_contributions: Developed advanced image and video generation pipelines using Diffusion models, featuring LoRA fine-tuning for product-specific customization.

Engineered controlled generation workflows and editing tools, including visual reference guidance, image stylization, high-resolution upscaling, text-guided inpainting/outpainting, and automated object removal.
Orchestrated an automated end-to-end video production system integrating multi-modal generation, AI-driven audio/speech synthesis, and automated video editing.
Integrated LLM-based prompt engineering and optimized inference with bitsandbytes quantization to improve generation quality and reduce memory usage.
Architected and deployed production-ready APIs using FastAPI, fully containerized with Docker for scalable AI solutions.
